title: Skies of Arcadia/S. Moves
text:
Each of the members of your party has the ability to learn a number of S. Moves. Their effects range from doing much more damage to one or more enemies, to healing and removing status effects from your party. Execution of S. Moves requires you to build up the required number of Spirit Points before they can be used.

S. Moves are learned by giving your party members Moonberries, which can be found in treasure chests or may be a reward after a battle.
